maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is commissions on newly sold and renewed Medicare and health insurance plans, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Most commissions come from Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplement plans sold for carriers, ultimately funded largely by Medicare.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by enrolling members through its own online and call-center brokerage, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Customers can buy plans through other brokers or directly from carriers; switching broker has little cost or disruption.

notes: Website text was only an error page; answers rely on prior knowledge of eHealth as a Medicare-focused insurance marketplace.
